Id.description: Unique id, sequential from 0. Used as TAPIR changelogId.

BC_description.description: Clear, detailed, evidence-backed description of the breaking change.

Reference.description: All sources: doc paths, URLs, issue/PR numbers, commit SHAs.

Changed_object.description: Everything needed to locate the affected code downstream.

type.description: call=method call changes; read/write=property get/set; import=import/require; config=external config file; environment=runtime env. Drives pattern generation.

className.description: Explicit class names impacted. '*' only if truly unknown. Wildcards allowed.

methodName.description: Exact method names (required when type is 'call'). Wildcards allowed.

propertyName.description: Explicit property names (required when type is 'read'/'write'). Wildcards allowed.

moduleName.description: Module names (required when type is 'import'/'config'). For 'config', the config file name (e.g. webpack.config.js). Use '*' alone only when the root package and all subpaths are affected.

targets.description: Preferred structured locator targets. Use this when module/class/member pairing or export shape matters; it takes precedence over legacy parallel arrays.

uncertain.description: Whether TAPIR may match unknown receiver provenance with ?**.

argFilters.description: OPTIONAL, type='call' only. Narrows a call BC to specific argument shapes (TAPIR call filters). WRITE THIS ONLY WHEN the docs/evidence clearly state the break is CONDITIONAL on argument count/type — it narrows matching and a wrong filter causes false negatives (missed affected code). Omit entirely when in doubt. See pattern-language.md.

minArgs.description: Minimum argument count. Emits [minArgs,maxArgs]. For 'at least N', set maxArgs to a large number (open ranges [n,] are not supported by the matcher).

maxArgs.description: Maximum argument count. Both minArgs and maxArgs must be set together to emit an arity filter.

argTypes.description: Per-argument type constraints. Each entry filters one positional argument.

types.description: Allowed types (union). One of: string, number, boolean, undefined, object, array, function, function1, function2, function3 — or a literal value. TAPIR reports high confidence when the current AST shape determines the predicate, and low confidence when it must conservatively assume a match.

Adaptation_method.description: Structured adaptation. Prefer direct Before->After code, e.g. 'base.text() -> base.textConverted()'.

RequireInfoFlag.description: true if affected entities, adaptation, or terminology are not fully clear/specified. If true, fill RequireInfo and refine via validation.md before pattern generation.

RequireInfo.description: What is missing/unclear. Empty only when RequireInfoFlag is false.
